about: server/chat-history.test.ts: reset scanning crosses chunk boundaries, excludes pre-clear full outputs and pending tools (the omp files without the padding: late.jsonl is the original's file with its padding record left out, so its clear sits in the same window, and its tool output after the clear is the one offered; cleared.jsonl ends at the clear, so the output before it is not offered. The 16 MiB padding that puts the clear one window before the end is not a case: its input would put 16 MiB in the repository)
